records.title: From Shortcut to Induction Head: How Data Diversity Shapes Algorithm Selection in Transformers
records.reason: This mechanistic study examines data diversity and algorithm selection/induction heads in transformers. It provides no concrete inference optimization or serving evaluation.

records.title: Large language models in supply chain management: a systematic literature review and application framework
records.reason: Publisher full text is subscriber restricted; accessible bibliographic/abstract records do not provide the primary full body.

records.title: LLaDA-Rec: Discrete Diffusion for Parallel Semantic ID Generation in Generative Recommendation
records.reason: LLaDA-Rec uses discrete diffusion to generate semantic IDs in parallel over T steps (T<=M), with adaptive masked-token prediction. This is a concrete parallel-generation idea but evaluated in recommendation rather than general LLM inference.

records.title: Among Us: Measuring and Mitigating Malicious Contributions in Model Collaboration Systems
records.reason: Among Us measures and mitigates malicious contributions in collaborative model systems; its focus is trust/security, not inference cost or throughput.

records.title: ZoFia: Zero-Shot Fake News Detection with Entity-Guided Retrieval and Multi-LLM Interaction
records.reason: ZoFia combines entity-guided retrieval and multiple LLM interactions for fake-news detection. It is an application pipeline and does not report an inference-efficiency technique; multi-model routing/cache transfer is unestablished.
